moments.author: Clem Delangue
moments.quote: We’re unveiling Microduck — a tiny $399 open‑source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning.
moments.why: A cute, programmable robot is making AI physical and affordable—sparking excitement in tech and maker circles.

moments.author: Hugging Face
moments.quote: We're unveiling Microduck 🐥🤖… teach new tricks with reinforcement learning.
moments.why: The company’s own post amplified the Microduck buzz, driving massive engagement across AI and robotics communities.

moments.author: Polymarket
moments.quote: Wendy’s new CEO admits the company “shortchanged” food quality to save money & is now trying to win back customer trust.
moments.why: A blunt admission from a fast‑food CEO hit a nerve—triggering waves of outrage and nostalgia among longtime customers.

moments.author: Bob Wright (via Wall Street Journal)
moments.quote: Wendy’s had “shortchanged ingredient quality for cost savings.”
moments.why: The candid self‑critique from Wendy’s CEO grabbed headlines and ignited angry reactions online and in Reddit threads.
